description:
⬇️ Get my e-book here! ⬇️

I'm Tom Brennan,

For 31 years on a small-town fire department I walked into other people's houses on the worst day they ever had, and most of the time the trouble had been sitting there for months: a dryer vent packed with lint, a furnace filter nobody had changed since spring, a water heater rumbling in the basement.

I'm retired now, I live in a 1910 farmhouse that keeps me busy, and this channel is my house check. Every week I take one part of the house (the furnace, the AC, the water heater, the dryer, the gutters, the pipes) and show you what to check, what you can fix yourself for a few dollars, and the habits that quietly wear things out and run your bills up.

No contractor upsell, no $2,000 gadget. Just what I'd tell my own family before they called somebody.

New videos every week. For winter safety and blackouts, see my other channel: @tombrennanofficial
